articles.content:

articles.content:
By viewer request, let's look at the "spec-driven vibe coding" development process mentioned in an earlier episode. We'll combine the fun of vibe-coding (getting the LLM to write 100% of the code for us) with the rigor and development discipline of only writing code from a detailed specification. We'll show the back-and-forth process between human and LLM, to lock down the specification to a sufficient level of detail, before implementation begins. And, we begin an exciting new long-term project to produce a fun new game!
